 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 9 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You may be looking for something in your treasure chest when you already have it lying right next to you. Leo , expand your vision and outlook. Look at all the possible outcomes that may be open and available to you. Not every road will feel like it is exactly black and white or fair—but life sometimes revolves around embracing the greys; accepting or acknowledging different points of view and then choosing to make your peace with yours while others make their peace with others. A new start, idea or vision is sprouting. Mull over it before you let it slide.
 Cosmic tip: Graciously accept the blessings surrounding you,u and life will find a way of making things fair.
